Source of Infection: Consumption of infected crustaceans, snails, prawns, crabs, frogs, and/or contaminated vegetables
Geography: South-east Asia, Pacific basin, Australia, Caribbean
Clinical Features: Paraesthesia of trunk, limbs, or face
Serology: Western blot of antibodies against 31 kD antigen*

Source of Infection: Consumption of infected poultry or fish, snakes, frogs
Geography: South-east Asia (mainly Thailand), emerging in sub-Saharan Africa
Clinical Features: Migrating subcutaneous swellings, creeping eruption, sharp radicular pain at onset
Serology: Western blot of antibodies against 24 kD antigen*
